definitions.explanation: The people and times that come after the present or after a given period. Used when speaking of what is handed down, remembered or judged in the future.

examples.english: To leave one's name to posterity.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後世|こうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: This work had a great influence on later generations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{後世|こうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{体験者|たいけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To pass on the memory of the war to later generations, the accounts of those who lived through it are being recorded.

notes:
A written word, common in history, culture and speeches about heritage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後世|こうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to hand down to later generations
- {後世|こうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave for posterity
- {後世|こうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧: people of later ages
- {後世|こうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧: the judgment of history

WATCH OUT:
The reading ごせ is a different, Buddhist word meaning the afterlife. こうせい also has many homophones (⟦{公正|こうせい}→公正：01751_kousei⟧, ⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧, ⟦{厚生|こうせい}→厚生：31137_kousei⟧); context decides.
